- fontFamily: ""
  $name: Font

- fontScale: 100
  $name: Text size (percent)
  $description: 50 to 200. Other values mean 100.
- language: ""
  $name: Language
  $description: A code such as de, fr, hi, ja. Leave empty to follow Windows.
